metadata.title: Triadic Reality Theory: Logic, Information, and Action as Irreducible Co-Primitives of Determinate Actuality
metadata.description: Triadic Reality Theory proposes that determinate actuality requires three irreducible co-primitives: L3 as ontological logical constraint, I-infinity as unbounded informational representability/differentiation, and A as fundamental state transition/change. The programme distinguishes representability, L3-admissibility, actualizability, and actuality; L3 is treated as a necessary filter without assuming that logical coherence alone exhausts metaphysical actualizability. TRT is offered as a candidate foundational ontology and research programme, not a completed physical theory.
metadata.notes: Working-draft version 0.10 incorporates the WP-TRT-CORE-0001 co-primitive normalization and is NOT for deposit; first deposit remains targeted at v1.0 after reference verification and public-copy review.
